body:
We would like to integrate the [cascade attention kernel](https://flashinfer.ai/2024/02/02/cascade-inference.html) from flashinfer.

Code pointers:
- Attention backend in sglang: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/flashinfer_backend.py
- Usage of cascade: https://docs.flashinfer.ai/api/python/cascade.html

comments.body: I'm glad to work on it!
@ZelinMa557 Are you in the [slack](https://join.slack.com/t/sgl-fru7574/shared_invite/zt-2ngly9muu-t37XiH87qvD~6rVBTkTEHw) channel? We can discuss it there.
it will be a very useful feature for the project I am working on, looking forward to it.

I made a pr to support it, maybe you can take a look? @guoyaol @merrymercy 
https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/5206

Hi @merrymercy @hnyls2002,

I came across this issue and looked into it — also went through #5206 to understand what was done there. The core idea worked (the benchmark showed solid speedups for shared-prefix batches), but the PR went stale before it was ready to merge.

From what I can tell, the main things still needed are CUDA graph support for the cascade path, fixing a few correctness issues in the cascade forward call (missing sm_scale, k_scale etc.), and proper tests. Happy to take a shot at a clean rewrite addressing these.

Before I dive in — is this still something you'd want merged? And is CUDA graph support a hard requirement upfront or can it come in a follow-up? Just want to make sure I'm not heading in the wrong direction before starting.

Thanks
Also available on SGLang Slack as "@ Manikanta Bandham" if easier to discuss there.
